record.interface_detail: SSH key login out of the box on Ubuntu 24.04.

record.binding_note: The vendor's NAT product page states a 500 GB/mo traffic allowance; that volume quota is the first constraint a larger monthly volume reaches.

record.reliability_note: NAT only, no dedicated public IPv4. Bandwidth is 20 Mbps, which constrains high-throughput workloads.
record.confidence_note: One reviewer's post from 2026-10-06; no vendor page was read. The vendor's own page would raise the rung.
